- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a summary of the Citi AAdvantage Executive credit card benefits and requirements:
  - Sign-up bonus: 50,000 AAdvantage miles after spending $5,000 within the first 3 months.
  - Earning structure: 2x miles on American Airlines purchases, 1x mile on all other purchases.
